company_line: Ace Reo processes and fabricates reinforcing steel for projects across Melbourne, Victoria and interstate from its Dandenong South head office.
subject: Civil Engineering Assistant, Dandenong South
paragraphs: I am applying for the Civil Engineering Assistant role at your Dandenong South head office, advertised on SEEK. Material take-offs, checking fabricated reinforcement against engineering drawings and keeping QA records is the kind of work I want to build my career on.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi in the Philippines (2014 to 2019), and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia. There I prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities and prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings and carried out inspections and quality checks. As a field engineer on subdivision finishing works I tracked materials and wrote site and progress reports.

I am based in Melton VIC with an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I have about a year of site experience rather than the two to three years in your advert, so I would start at junior level and learn your production systems quickly.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.
